observable: Tibial tray fracture rate under cyclic loading (10,000 cycles, 1000 N load)
baseline: Control group (tibial tray without FRP sleeve)
conditions: Cyclic loading conditions: 10,000 cycles, 1000 N load, 37°C ± 2°C temperature, 50% ± 10% relative humidity
falsifier: If the tibial tray fracture rate under cyclic loading is not reduced by at least 35% compared to the control group, or if the fracture rate is increased by more than 10% compared to the control group.
